classdef.name: ParagraphBorderTopOriginEnum
classdef.shortdesc: Options for specifying basis of the top origin of the paragraph border.

property.name: ASCENT_TOP_ORIGIN
property.shortdesc: Makes the paragraph border top origin based on ascent of the text in the paragraph.

property.name: BASELINE_TOP_ORIGIN
property.shortdesc: Makes the paragraph border top origin based on baseline of the text in the paragraph.

property.name: LEADING_TOP_ORIGIN
property.shortdesc: Makes the paragraph border top origin based on leading of the text in the paragraph.
